summary: Davis Joint Unified School District urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, rejecting proposals to sunset or eliminate it, and emphasizes the program's essential role in providing reliable broadband for modern public education. Support for the connectivity and internal network infrastructure schools need to provide reliable educational access; and Work with schools and other stakeholders to strengthen and modernize E-Rate rather than reduce its role in public education.

claims.argument: Davis Joint Unified School District has received $1.29 million in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $257,369 a year toward the connections our students depend on
claims.evidence_quote: Davis Joint Unified School District has received $1.29 million in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $257,369 a year toward the connections our students depend on.

claims.argument: Limiting or sunsetting E-Rate would reduce funding for connectivity and infrastructure needed by schools
claims.evidence_quote: Our students deserve access to the tools they need to learn and succeed regardless of where they live or their family’s financial circumstances. I urge the Commission to protect E-Rate and ensure that public schools can continue providing students with reliable, affordable, and effective connectivity.
